{{Quote|Ambush! Sarge is hit! We need the Jedi back here!|Garcy at the Battle of Essien|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic: War 1">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 1|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Garcy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Phaeda/Legends|Phaeda]]. He was a member of the [[Phaeda Militia]], and took part in the assault against [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] at the [[Essien landing]].
